reader.requirement: At --std 85 an FD that carries a REPORT clause (in any clause order) must be refused when any record description entry follows it, and accepted (with no 1985 'record description required' refusal) when none does.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 refuses an FD with no record description (COBOL1837, §1985:VII.3.2.3 SR3); a report file returns before the test, so the report-file arm is the same at every edition

reader.edition-search: Read BindFileSection's FD arm (the IsReportFile && dataDescriptionEntry().Length > 0 check after the clause loop) and MaterializeImpliedRecord; the SR4 check itself reads no edition (only the Edition diagnostic sink).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1171_report_file_legal_references is the legal half only; the refusal (a record under a report FD, the REPORT clause before another clause) is not exercised by it

probes.printed: EXIT 65; error COBOL2578: file description entry 'RPT' specifies a REPORT clause and has 1 record description or constant entry subordinate to it
probes.expected: refused: No record description entries may follow the file description entry for a report file

probes.printed: EXIT 65; error COBOL2578 ... has 4 record description or constant entries (REPORT clause written before LABEL RECORDS; two 01 records, one a group)

probes.expected: a report FD with REPORT and LABEL RECORDS and no records compiles and runs (no COBOL1837)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR4  (3.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: The check sits after the FD clause loop so the REPORT clause may come in any position; the 1985-only COBOL1837 'records required' refusal is skipped for a report file because MaterializeImpliedRecord returns on IsReportFile first. Cosmetic: the message counts every data description entry (p1b says 4 for two records with two subordinates) and cites only §2023:13.4.5.3 SR8 at --std 85.
